workflow: agent-drafted multi-view concept from repo references (Meshy image-to-image nano-banana-pro) -> Meshy multi-image-to-3d (latest, quad remesh, PBR)
target_size_m: 45 m tall, ~14 m base, flat grassy top shelf with 2 tiny pines

scale_normalisation.method: lossless: GLB scene roots wrapped in node 'metres_root' with uniform scale + translation; base at y=0, footprint centred on x/z

concepts.prompt: Free-standing tall sea-stack rock spire for a sky-island biome, about 45 metres tall with a roughly 14 metre wide base, slightly tapering column built from clearly stacked horizontal limestone strata beds with small mossy ledges between the beds and a few shallow overhangs. Flat grassy top shelf with two tiny pine trees on it. Same rock language as the references (weathered pale limestone cliffs with moss). Tall narrow silhouette, roughly 3:1 height to width. Stylised-realism game asset in the Palworld / Animo art style, single isolated object on a plain neutral background, even soft daylight, no cast background, no people. Materials: pale warm-grey weathered limestone (#9a8f80 to #b8ad9c, never pure white) with clearly stacked horizontal sedimentary strata and soft moss on the ledges; where present, slate-blue roof tile (#3d4a66), honey-coloured timber, cream plaster, royal-blue banner fabric with a small gold accent. Absolutely no red, no oxblood, no maroon anywhere. Flat ground contact at the base.
concepts.verdict: rejected: no pines on top, sandy tone

visual_verdict: Strong: clean stacked-strata limestone column with mossy ledges and two pines on the flat top; reads as the reference sea-stacks. Base flares wider than brief (23 x 19 m at 45 m tall) because of ledge overhangs. Tone slightly warm/beige.
